mapper.select: select sd.id, sd.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, sd.metric_code, sm.metric_name, sd.metric_value, sm.unit, sd.collected_at, sd.source_type, sd.quality_flag from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code where (#{warehouseId} is null or sd.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId}) and (#{metricCode} is null or #{metricCode} = '' or sd.metric_code = #{metricCode}) order by sd.collected_at asc

select sd.id, sd.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, sd.metric_code, sm.metric_name, sd.metric_value, sm.unit, sd.collected_at, sd.source_type, sd.quality_flag from sensor_data sd join warehouse w on sd.warehouse_id = w.id join sensor_metric sm on sd.metric_code = sm.metric_code where sd.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} and sd.metric_code = #{metricCode} order by sd.collected_at asc limit 24
mapper.insert: insert into sensor_data ( warehouse_id, metric_code, metric_value, collected_at, source_type, source_batch_no, quality_flag, remark, created_by ) values ( #{warehouseId}, #{metricCode}, #{metricValue}, #{collectedAt}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceBatchNo}, #{qualityFlag}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} )

insert into sensor_data ( warehouse_id, metric_code, metric_value, collected_at, source_type, source_batch_no, quality_flag, remark, created_by ) values
( #{item.warehouseId}, #{item.metricCode}, #{item.metricValue}, #{item.collectedAt}, #{item.sourceType}, #{item.sourceBatchNo}, #{item.qualityFlag}, #{item.remark}, #{item.createdBy} )
